From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>

Subject: Scheduling: Senior Infrastructure SWE loop — Zoom + accessibility check

Hi Jonathan,

Thanks again for interviewing with Redwood — excited to keep things moving. We’d like to schedule a 60-minute interview loop with our infra team. Please let me know if any of these windows work in your Pacific time zone:

- Mon 3/2, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Tue 3/3, 14:00–15:00 PT
- Wed 3/4, 09:30–10:30 PT

A few quick items so we can set you up correctly:
- Any accessibility needs (live captions, ASL interpreter, extended breaks)?
- Preferred pronouns to share with the panel?
- Do you want us to attach your resume to the calendar invite (we have the version you uploaded but can swap if needed)?

Also, if you prefer a 30-minute buffer before/after the loop to take notes/decompress, we can try to reserve that on our side.

If you confirm availability and any accommodations, I’ll send a calendar invite with the Zoom link and a short agenda.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Technical Recruiter | Redwood Inference
pri...@redwood.ai

Hi Priya,

Thanks — Tue 3/3, 14:00–15:00 PT works great for me. I do need live captioning and would like the session to be captioned in real time (I use captions to follow fast exchanges). If possible, please also include a phone dial-in fallback.

Pronouns: he/him.

Please attach the latest resume I submitted (the PDF labeled "Choe_Jonathan_resume_2026.pdf"). A 30-minute buffer afterward would be helpful if that’s not a problem.

Appreciate it — looking forward to the loop.

—Jonathan

Jonathan — great, we’ve locked Tue 3/3, 14:00–15:00 PT and attached the calendar invite. Agenda is attached as a one-page PDF. Quick logistics:

- Zoom link (panel will use host account): https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=redwood-test
- We’ll enable live captions and provide a dial-in fallback number in the invite.
- Interviewers (approx): Laura B. (Infra Lead – system design + scaling), Marcus L. (Interview owner — architecture deep dives), Aleks V. (SRE pairing + incident design).
- Run order: 10m quick intros and goal-setting, 40m whiteboard + system discussion, 10m candidate questions + next steps.

Recruiter notes for the panel (Priya): please remind interviewers to speak slowly for the captioning accuracy, and avoid interrupting during long responses — candidate will be using captions. Also, please mark no-recording in the invite and ask permission if anyone suggests otherwise.

Attached: swe-interview-agenda.pdf, calendar-invite.ics

See you then — Marcus

Thanks Marcus — that agenda looks good. A couple quick asks: could you include the interviewer pronouns on the invite? I find it helps set the tone. Also I prefer that the first 10 minutes are not technical — I use that time to ground myself and run through any assistive tech.

On recording: I don’t consent to any recording of my interview. If the panel routinely records for calibration, please confirm it will be disabled for this session.

Resume file name is correct.

Thanks,
—Jonathan
